        reference = "CVE-2024-3094"
        date = "2026-04-09"

        $y = "xz_dec_run" fullword ascii

    condition:
        uint32be(0) == 0x00005A78 and all of them
}

rule Suspicious_Rundll32_Temp_Load {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading DLL from user Temp directory"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        malware_family = "Fileless Malware"
    strings:
        $temp_path = /\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9\\._-]+\.dll/i
        $rundll32 = "rundll32.exe" nocase
    condition:
        $rundll32 and $temp_path
}
